result.title: ActionRAG: Evidence-Refining Graph Diffusion for Long-Term Memory in LLM Agents
result.summary: LLM agents need long-term memory that can recover precise and mutually consistent evidence from growing interaction histories, particularly when answers depend on relations among facts rather than isolated semantic matches. Current memory pipelines remain vulnerable at two stages: indexing errors can fragment repeated entities or merge distinct ones, and online retrieval often treats initial similarity scores as final even when the surrounding graph provides evidence for revising them. We introduce ActionRAG, a graph memory architecture that couples cautious indexing with query-time graph retroevaluation. Its indexing pipeline reconciles type labels and applies tiered entity resolution. Given a query, dual-channel entity and triple retrieval forms an initial evidence set and induces a bounded local graph. Query-conditioned receiver-normalized diffusion refines triple scores using local path structure. Seed protection, hub-penalized flux, and triple materialization preserve direct evidence while recovering missed connections. We evaluate ActionRAG on MemoryAgentBench (MAB), which tests accurate retrieval, conflict resolution, long-range understanding, and test-time learning. Across its eight deterministic-scoring columns, ActionRAG achieves 55.1 average accuracy, improving over the strongest retrieval-based memory baseline by 5.4 points. Under MAB's query-time cost accounting, mean synthesis cost stays below \$0.001 per query on the four reported cost columns, and the sum of separately measured retrieval-side p99 components is 440.7 ms on our consumer Apple Silicon setup.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ActionRAG：面向 LLM agent 长期记忆的图记忆架构，索引端做类型标签校准与分层实体消解，查询端用双通道实体/三元组检索构造局部图，并以查询条件的接收端归一化扩散重估三元组分数（含种子保护、hub 惩罚、三元组实体化）。在 MemoryAgentBench 上平均 55.1，较最强检索基线高 5.4 点，并报告查询成本与延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不把初始相似度当最终分数、用局部图路径结构做查询时重估」的机制，可能可供核查如何用于 LVR 中视觉或跨模态证据的筛选与 latent 相似度的结构化重排；但全文为纯文本记忆检索，与视觉推理状态生成无直接联系。
